motion: The camera keeps tracking slowly and steadily backwards along the chalk track at the same speed, low to the ground, ahead of the small grey six-wheeled delivery robot. The robot keeps rolling after it at the same pace, staying the same size in frame, its amber beacon glowing and its torn bunting swaying across its front wheels. The long line of people keeps walking steadily along the curving track behind it, the old man with his stick and the woman with the blanket trolley at the front. The wind moves through the long grass. Nothing new appears in the grass. Every person keeps their shape. It never stops.
